link_footer: {name} is also a channel for talking to Persona. Set which chat its messages go to, plus questions and notifications, under Channels.
title: Channels
intro: Talk to Persona from anywhere. Messages go to the main chat (or the chat you pick), replies go back where they came from, and agent questions and approvals are sent there too. Once you answer somewhere else, they stop waiting.
disable_footer: When off, it stops receiving messages. Binding and settings are kept.
binding_footer: Only messages from the bound person go to Persona. Anyone else just gets a reply that it only serves the person it's bound to.
target_footer: Sending /new in the chat to start a new chat, or /main to go back to the main chat, changes this too.
test_footer: Only sent to you, the bound account.
settings_elsewhere: This channel is set up elsewhere.
unbind_body: Messages to the bot in {name} will no longer reach Persona, and pending replies and questions won't be sent there. To use it again, bind it again.
main_chat_hint: Pick up where the main chat left off
new_chat_hint: The next message starts a new chat, and later ones go there
qr_footer: Scan with {name} on your phone. This continues once you confirm.
bind_footer: Once bound, only your messages to the bot go to Persona.
waiting_pair: Waiting for you to send it to the bot in {name}…
